State of Decay 3 developer Undead Labs has confirmed that it underwent "significant" layoffs following its independence from Xbox.

This direction of travel was previously confirmed a few months back, when the developer said that it was "transitioning out of Xbox".

Holt goes on to acknowledge that lengthy relationship: "Microsoft has been part of the State of Decay story from the very beginning, and we’re proud of everything we’ve accomplished together."

Despite the shift, State of Decay 3 remains in development — which makes sense, seeing as it was announced over six whole years ago at this point.
